crossRefs.note: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.
When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.
Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed…
They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.

translations.web: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.
translations.bsb: At that time the chief priests and elders of the people assembled in the courtyard of the high priest, whose name was Caiaphas,
translations.kjv: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
translations.asv: Then were gathered together the chief priests, and the elders of the people, unto the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas;
